caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects, each shown from a different angle, rendered predominantly in shades of brown with reddish and darker accents to suggest rust or aged metal. The objects have a symmetrical, oval-shaped upper section with an inner bar crossing vertically. Attached to the bottom are horizontal bars with rounded edges, from which chains and small, rectangular pendants dangle. Both objects have circular loops at the top, and the right object is illustrated in a three-quarters side view, showing additional depth and overlapping features, such as a curled element and more pronounced links in the chains. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and both items are detailed to show texture, shadow, and worn surfaces.
title: Bridle Bit
